scope: Emmy Noether Paper 20, Ein algebraisches Kriterium fuer absolute Irreduzibilitaet, Math. Ann. 85 (1922), pp. 26-33; dense-display source audit against the current R259 German base after WebR252.
result: No TeX patch promoted. The package is a compact witness/audit package for high-risk P20 dense-display anchors and final proof/date lines.
checked_loci: printed p26: title, byline, opening theorem, footnotes 1-2
printed p27: formulas (1)-(3), binomial count, ideal lead-in
printed p28: Primideal paragraph, homogenization, Kronecker substitution, formula (4)
printed p29: formulas (5)-(8), induced exponents, varphi/psi/chi opening
printed p30: formulas (9)-(12), norm identities, footnote 9
printed p31: repeated printed number (12), formula (13), formula (14)
printed p32: formula (15), S(Z,u) display, formula (16)
printed p33: Ostrowski proof close and final date
source_quality: Best staged local witnesses are mixed native GDZ 400/600 ppi pages with labelled enlarged crops. The enlarged crops are inspection witnesses and do not make the source native 1000 ppi.
public_policy: Treat as source-audit/no-patch support material, not as a reader release.
Do not call this Paper 20 certification, whole-Noether certification, source closure, multilingual synchronization, or a critical edition.
If uploaded, do not front above reader PDFs/TeX; fold into the next deliberate Noether source-audit support rollup or file-count rebalance.
